subject: Question about randomly sampled covariates in regression models

messages.author: c5b4a1199682ea80
messages.subject: Question about randomly sampled covariates in regression models
parts:
Trying to fit a logistic regression model in which the categories of the covariate or only known as proportions that differ for each data point (i.e. for each data point n out of N, the covariate has level ‘1’, ‘2’…C according to the probabilities propCat[n, 1:C]).

In practice, this could be the proportions of countries covered by different climate zones; assigning the climate zones to biological samples recorded from different countries involves some uncertainty as some countries are covered by multiple climate zones. Sampling the covariate according to % coverage by climate zones should account for this uncertainty in inference.

 

Possible to implement this in RStan? Thanks!

 

 

This is a malfunctioned Stan code

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(

  "

 

data {

            int<lower=0> N;        

            int<lower=0> C;

            int<lower=0, upper=1> Obs[N];        

            matrix[N,C] propCat;

}

parameters {

            real mu;

            real<lower=0, upper=1> pi1; 

            vector[C] beta;

            int<lower=1> clim[N];

}

model {

 

            for(n in 1:N)

                        clim[n]~categorical(propClimZone[n]);

            for(n in 1:N)

                        Obs[n] ~ bernoulli_logit(mu +beta * clim[n]);

            beta ~ normal(0, 10);

}

"

, file="model.stan")

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------

 

 

This data-generating R code

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------

 

set.seed(1)

N = 20

Obs = rbinom(N, 1, 0.4)

p.clim1 <- round(runif(N, 0,1), 2)

propClimZone <- matrix(NA, ncol=2, nrow=N)

propClimZone[,1] <-  p.clim1

propClimZone[,2] <-  1- p.clim1

C=2

dat2stan = list(N = N, C = C, Obs = Obs, propCat = propClimZone)

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Question about randomly sampled covariates in regression models
parts:
Stan doesn't support integer parameters. And it looks
like clin[n] doesn't have an upper bound, so you won't be
able to marginalize it out by brute force.

And you have an undefined variable propClimZone.

But I don't see what this has to do with the structure of
covariates or what you mean by sampling covariates.

- Bob
